nodes.description: Temperature effect on 4 nm WO3 sample: crystallite growth and transformation monitoring by Raman spectroscopy

observation.value: broadband at 800 cm⁻¹ splits, 950 cm⁻¹ band disappears

nodes.source_text: Figure 2 shows that temperature has practically no effect on the Raman spectra of the 4 nm sample between 77 and 600 K... at 700 K the broadband at 800 cm⁻¹ splits into two components and the high-frequency band at about 950 cm⁻¹ disappears... The final spectrum after returning to 300 K is characteristic of the 16 nm sample.

nodes.description: Temperature-induced β→α structural transition for 16 nm WO3 monitored by Raman spectroscopy
nodes.source_text: Figure 3 represents the spectral changes for the 16 nm sample resulting from a reversible structural change at about 800 K... This transition takes place 471 K lower than the bulk WO₃.

nodes.description: Temperature-induced β→α tetragonal transformation for 35 nm WO3 monitored by Raman spectroscopy

spectral_features.value: bands broaden, 58 cm⁻¹ mode reduced, intensity loss

nodes.source_text: For the 35 nm sample... one observes changes in its Raman spectrum (Fig. 4) at about 800 K. All the bands become broader, the low-frequency mode at about 58 cm⁻¹ is strongly reduced... Compared to the bulk WO₃, the transition is downshifted by 300 K.

nodes.description: Temperature-induced γ→β→α transitions and crystallite growth for 60 nm WO3
nodes.source_text: The 60 nm sample undergoes a first transition at 550 K probably from its γ-structure to the β one and a second transition towards the α-phase at about 950 K; however, the beginning of the crystallite growth process is observed simultaneously.

nodes.description: High-pressure Raman study of 35 nm WO3: hydrostatic and non-hydrostatic conditions up to 34 GPa
nodes.source_text: The pressure dependence of the 35 nm samples in hydro- and non-hydrostatic conditions is similar (Fig. 9). In both cases, the decompression gives the initial structure... Three transitions can be evidenced...

nodes.description: High-pressure Raman study of 4 nm WO3 under hydrostatic conditions
nodes.source_text: The pressure dependence of the 2 and 4 nm samples is similar... In the case of the 4 nm sample in a transmitting medium, one observes a spectrum change at 34 GPa. The broadband at 800 cm⁻¹ disappears completely while a new broadband spreading from 400 to 600 cm⁻¹ is observed.

nodes.description: Temperature stability study of 2 nm WO3 sample
nodes.source_text: No spectral changes are observed in the 77-300 K range for the 2 nm sample, above 300 K it starts to lose some water and its spectrum evolves continuously towards the spectrum of the 4 nm sample.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns at room temperature: 60 nm sample mainly γ-phase (P2₁/n structure) with refined parameters a=7.3043 Å, b=7.5313 Å, c=7.6833 Å, β=90.7645°; 35 nm sample α-phase (P4/ncc) with a=5.2386 Å, c=7.6670 Å; 2 nm and 4 nm samples show broad bands indicating amorphous state.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diagrams were obtained on a Siemens D500 diffractometer at room temperature... The diffractogram of the 60 nm sample is mainly representative of the γ-phase and the corresponding parameters were refined... The 35 nm diffractogram corresponds to the α-phase and the parameters a=5.2386 Å and c=7.6670 Å were obtained.

nodes.characterization_summary: Room temperature Raman spectra used for crystallite size estimation via low-frequency band position: ~263 cm⁻¹ (4 nm), ~265 cm⁻¹ (16 nm), 268 cm⁻¹ (35 nm), 275 cm⁻¹ (60 nm); 2-4 nm samples show surface mode at ~960 cm⁻¹ and amorphous character.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The 16 nm crystallites sample was obtained by heating the 4 nm sample... the crystallite size was estimated from the wavenumber of the Raman band at about 265 cm⁻¹ which increases approximately linearly from 263 cm⁻¹ for 4 nm to 268 and 275 cm⁻¹ for 35 and 60 nm samples...

nodes.characterization_summary: Temperature-induced phase transitions downshifted: 60 nm γ→β at 550 K, β→α at 950 K; 35 nm β→α at 800 K; 16 nm β→α at 700 K; 4 nm and 2 nm amorphous stable up to 600 K.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The 60 nm sample undergoes a first transition at 550 K probably from its γ-structure to the β one and a second transition towards the α-phase at about 950 K...

nodes.characterization_summary: High-pressure Raman shows phase transitions shifted to higher pressures for 35 nm sample: HP1 (P21/c) at 1.5-2 GPa (vs 0.1 GPa bulk), HP3 at 21-31 GPa (vs 14 GPa bulk); 4 nm shows HP4 transition at 34 GPa.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the 35 nm sample, an increase of some transition pressures compared to the bulk oxide was observed... This HP1 phase is induced at a higher pressure for the 35 nm sample than for the bulk WO3.
